2608.06613.title: Do 3D Medical Foundation Models See Through MRI Artifacts? A Controlled Study of Representation Robustness
2608.06613.paper_summary: Self-supervised 3D medical foundation models are increasingly used as general-purpose feature extractors, yet their sensitivity to MRI artifacts remains poorly understood. We present a controlled evaluation of representation robustness across five pretrained 3D encoders spanning different architectures, objectives, pretraining domains, and dataset scales. Using BraTS-Africa cases with four MRI sequences, we generate seven frequency- and image-domain artifacts at five predefined corruption settings. Robustness is assessed using linear centered kernel alignment (CKA), RankMe, and UMAP, complemented by an independent segmentation-consistency analysis. We find that robustness is strongly model- and artifact-dependent. 3DINO exhibits the most consistently stable representations, while BrainIAC is highly sensitive to several corruptions; NeuroVFM, BrainFM, and Neuro-SimCLR show intermediate but distinct artifact-specific profiles. Across many conditions, CKA decreases substantially while RankMe remains comparatively stable, indicating that artifacts often distort representation geometry without causing dimensional collapse. Segmentation consistency also degrades under corruption, particularly for ghosting and Rician noise, but aligns only partially with representation-level robustness. These findings show that larger-scale or domain-specific pretraining alone does not guarantee artifact invariance and motivate explicit robustness evaluation before deploying 3D foundation models in heterogeneous MRI settings.
2608.06613.paper_summary_zh: 自我監督的3D醫療基礎模型越來越多地被用作通用特徵提取器，但它們對MRI伪影的敏感性仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們對五個預訓練的3D編碼器進行了受控評估，這些編碼器涵蓋了不同的架構、目標、預訓練領域和數據集規模。<lb/>使用BraTS-Africa案例的四個MRI序列，我們在五個預定的損壞設置下生成了七種頻率和圖像域的伪影。<lb/>通過線性中心核對齊（CKA）、RankMe和UMAP來評估穩健性，並輔以獨立的分割一致性分析。<lb/>我們發現，穩健性強烈依賴於模型和伪影。<lb/>3DINO顯示出最穩定的一致性表示，而BrainIAC對幾種損壞高度敏感；NeuroVFM、BrainFM和Neuro-SimCLR則顯示出中等但明顯的伪影特定特徵。<lb/>在許多條件下，CKA顯著下降，而RankMe則保持相對穩定，這表明伪影通常會扭曲表示幾何形狀，但不會導致維度崩潰。<lb/>在損壞下，分割一致性也會下降，特別是對於鬼影和Rician噪聲，但與表示層級的穩健性僅部分一致。<lb/>這些發現表明，僅僅依賴於更大規模或領域特定的預訓練並不能保證對伪影的不變性，並促使在異質MRI環境中部署3D基礎模型之前進行明確的穩健性評估。
